plugin.name: Preset Agents
plugin.description: General-purpose agent personas shipped with the host: Master, Developer, Researcher
agent.master.name: Master
agent.master.description: Owns the goal end to end: plans the workflow, delegates each step, accepts or reworks results.
agent.developer.name: Developer
agent.developer.description: Produces the core asset: code, a substantive draft, or a worked analysis.
agent.researcher.name: Researcher
agent.researcher.description: Collects facts, documentation, prior art, and market signals, and verifies them.
